source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps the father designation and all participating groups without historical harmonization.
Retains the bodily description rather than reducing it to fear alone.
Preserves all three rewards and the uncertain ordinal title without explanatory genealogy.
Retains the queen’s divine plural and emphatic repetition of father.
Repeats the promised honors and the conditional offer intact.
Preserves the four royal gifts and their giver.
Preserves the charge of knowledgeable refusal and the stated son relationship.
Preserves the doubled first word and the inscription’s plural last form.
Renders the counting wordplay and completion as Daniel’s explanation.
Keeps the weighing image and adverse result.
Retains the singular interpretive form and the named recipients of rule.
Preserves the honors despite the earlier refusal, without inventing Daniel’s response.
Preserves received, approximate age, and identity without identifying him with another ruler.
